density.live-pitch: presented to a room: one idea a page, about 40 body words or fewer, the largest type
density.executive: presented or sent: about 95 to 120 body words a page with commentary beside the evidence
density.pre-read: read alone without a presenter: 120 body words a page and up, commentary carrying the argument

options.label: design: "consulting"
options.note: Consulting: Steering committees, board papers and diligence, where the reader expects the familiar analytical grammar.

options.label: design: "editorial"
options.note: Editorial: Pre-reads, strategy narratives and essays read alone, where the argument is carried by sentences as much as by charts.

options.label: design: "journal"
options.note: Data journal: Evidence-led briefings where the charts carry the argument and the reader wants the finding and the proof, fast.

options.label: design: "keynote"
options.note: Keynote: Decks presented to a room, launches and pitches, where each page has to land at a glance from the back of the room.

options.label: palette: "midnight"
options.note: the consulting system's own colours. Serif display titles on an open canvas, deep navy with an electric-blue accent, dash bullets, zebra tables

options.label: palette: "evergreen"
options.note: Regular-weight titles on an open canvas, green pill date tags, plain chart headings with inline units, green bar families

options.label: palette: "crimson"
options.note: Light regular titles, grey bar families with the answer in red, red KPI call-outs, annotation rails

options.label: palette: "graphite"
options.note: Black ink with a bright green accent, regular titles, green chart families, ring KPIs

options.label: tracker: "pills"
options.note: every section as a pill, the current one filled

options.label: tracker: "label"
options.note: the current section's name, above the title

options.label: tracker: "breadcrumb"
options.note: the section under its parent

options.label: tracker: "number-strip"
options.note: section numbers on a rail, the current one filled

options.label: tracker: false
options.note: no tracker on the pages

options.label: titleRule: "system"
options.note: the consulting system's own

options.label: titleRule: "rule"
options.note: a thin rule, margin to margin

options.label: titleRule: "full"
options.note: a hairline, edge to edge

options.label: titleRule: "bar"
options.note: a short accent bar

options.label: titleRule: "band"
options.note: a tinted band behind the title

options.label: titleRule: "block"
options.note: the title reversed out of a colour block

options.label: titleRule: "tab"
options.note: an accent tab at the top edge

options.label: titleRule: "none"
options.note: no rule; the page stays open

options.label: surfaces: "reference"
options.note: filled table headers, a tinted label column, filled cards, heavier marks

options.label: surfaces: "open"
options.note: type on the canvas: ruled headers, plain columns, outlined cards, light marks
